summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a repurchase of 11,850,000 ordinary shares at a VWAP of 94.4524 pence per share, executed by Goldman Sachs International as broker. The buyback is part of a program announced on January 30, 2026, and shares will be canceled. This open-market purchase is a capital return event. As a routine share buyback under existing authority, no board recommendation or advisor is needed. The trades were made under UK Market Abuse Regulation. Risk-arb is irrelevant here; watch for future buyback pace or cancellation impact on EPS.
